title: Capture full failure context in the concurrent same-key reference publication test
outcome: Capture failure context for the concurrent same-key reference-publication test through its contender/status/body assertion and separate test-only stage/raw-error/SQLite diagnostics, with deterministic forced-error formatting coverage and no production semantics, timing, retry or budget change. This observability increment does not diagnose or close the parent bug.
acceptance: The concurrent same-key reference-publication test's failure assertion reports the failing contender index, HTTP status and response body. For instrumented server-error paths, separate cfg(test) diagnostic output reports the failing stage and raw error, including the SQLite primary and extended result codes when the underlying error is SQLite. A deterministic forced-error test verifies that this diagnostic formatting retains those fields. This increment does not promise per-request correlation, exhaustive coverage of every server-error return or diagnosis of the parent bug.
The change is test-only or cfg(test)-only observation: production behaviour, error mapping, timing, retries and budgets are unchanged, as shown by the diff and the review pair.
The full maintained gate passes on the final input, and an independent review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.

completion.summary: Landed test-only reference-publication failure context: contender/status/body assertions and cfg(test) stage/raw-error/SQLite diagnostics, with deterministic forced-error formatter coverage. Production behavior unchanged. Exact treec2c3340f pushed as8207cc3f on origin/master.
